_comment: Source manifest for content generated through quran.ai MCP. Every Quran-related item added by the quran.ai pipeline is recorded here so judges can verify it is source-grounded and not invented. Generated during development; the runtime app does NOT call quran.ai live.

quranText.description: Canonical Arabic Quran text from quran.com / Quran Foundation

translation.name: The Qur'an
translation.author: Muhammad A. S. Abdel Haleem
translation.note: Used for ALL new ayahs added by the quran.ai pipeline. Pre-existing ayahs in quranContent.js use Saheeh International phrasing and were not changed.

tafsir.name: التفسير الميسر
tafsir.author: مجمع الملك فهد لطباعة المصحف الشريف
tafsir.description: Committee-produced simplified Arabic tafsir, officially distributed with the Madinah mushaf. Neutral, mainstream Sunni interpretation. Concise.

tafsir.name: تيسير الكريم الرحمن في تفسير كلام المنان
tafsir.author: عبد الرحمن بن ناصر السعدي
tafsir.description: Benefits-oriented tafsir extracting practical guidance from each passage. Educational (tarbawi) focus — well suited for child-friendly paraphrase.

themes.note: 14:7 and 31:12 were already present and verified in earlier work; only 14:34 is newly added by the quran.ai pipeline.

themes.selectionNote: Brief listed 2:222, 3:134, 3:146, 3:159, 5:42, 49:9 as candidates. After fetching translations, 2:222 (mentions menstruation) and 5:42 (deals with judging hypocrites and unlawful gain) were excluded as not child-appropriate for ages 7+. Four clearly child-friendly 'Allah loves ___' verses retained.
All 8 candidate ayahs from the brief were verified and retained. Three mini-quests reference these ayahs.

Knowing Allah Garden vertical slice. One quest per Name-of-Allah theme: 1:1 (Ar-Rahman, Ar-Rahim — Mercy), 67:14 (Al-Lateef, Al-Khabeer — Knowledge), 59:24 (Al-Khaliq, Al-Bari, Al-Musawwir — Creation). 1:1 reuses local dataset entry; 67:14 and 59:24 are new in v3. All three ayahs were re-verified through quran.ai in this iteration with fetch_quran (ar-simple-clean), fetch_translation (en-abdel-haleem), fetch_tafsir (ar-muyassar).

excludedAyahs.reason: Translation mentions menstruation — not appropriate for the 7+ child audience even though it contains 'Allah loves those who turn to Him and those who keep themselves clean.'
Translation deals with judging hypocrites and unlawful gain — context too complex for a child-friendly 'Allah loves the just' card. 49:9 covers al-muqsiteen with a clearer context.

groundingDisclosure: All Quran-related content (Arabic text, translations, and the underlying tafsir paraphrased into child-friendly summaries) was fetched live from quran.ai during content authoring. The simplified explanations in quranAiContentPack.js are model paraphrases of the fetched ar-muyassar and ar-saadi tafsir, written for ages 7+ in plain English. They are NOT verbatim quotes of either tafsir. Following quran.ai's grounding rules, this synthesis is labeled as 'derived from fetched tafsir' rather than presented as direct scholarly quotation.
runtimeBehavior: The app does NOT call quran.ai at runtime. All content is cached in quranAiContentPack.js for demo reliability. See docs/quran-ai-content-pipeline.md for how to regenerate the pack.
